name: jkpark-claude-plugin
description: Personal Claude Code plugin. Skills: idea-refiner (iterative Korean Q&A that turns a vague idea into a buildable spec), plan-writer (the step after idea-refiner — scans the codebase for a reuse map, interviews until every plan-shaping decision is settled, then turns the 기획서 into a very detailed code-level Korean implementation plan with milestones, code sketches, and verifiable completion criteria, saved under the project's docs/plan convention), tech-blog-writer (research a topic/article and publish an image-rich, junior-friendly Korean tech blog post as HTML), obs (save content into an Obsidian vault as a tagged folder-note and update the index), obs-recall (search that vault as a personal knowledge base, including attached HTML), obs-html (interview the user on length and requirements, then write an image-rich Korean HTML document and file it into the vault via obs), obs-ppt (interview-driven PPT-style HTML slide decks — research a new topic or convert an existing document into a self-contained 16:9 deck with keyboard navigation and toggleable speaker notes, then file it into the vault via obs), analyze-image (look at an image the user wants analyzed without making them mention the clipboard — checks the macOS clipboard first by default), ios-project-setup (scaffold an xcodegen-based iOS repo for Claude Code and CI — scans project.yml for the repo's real values, then writes the generated-file guard hook, the SwiftFormat hook, a merged .claude/settings.json, a scan-backed Korean CLAUDE.md, and TestFlight / dev-version-bump GitHub Actions workflows, skipping any artifact whose preconditions the repo does not meet), testflight-credentials (register the Apple resources an iOS app needs before its first TestFlight upload — creates the App ID and an Apple Distribution certificate through the App Store Connect API, builds the CSR and .p12 locally with openssl, verifies the .p12 imports the way CI imports it, and loads the five signing secrets into GitHub Actions, while walking the user through the two steps Apple offers no API for), testflight-release (ship the current dev branch to TestFlight — preflights the TestFlight workflow's push-to-main trigger, the dev/main branches, the worktree, and dev/origin sync, shows the commits that would ship for approval, then merges dev into main with a --no-ff merge commit, pushes, and verifies with gh run list that the workflow actually started), and skill-generator (interview-driven creation and auditing of Claude Code skills — collects real sample artifacts, generates English SKILL.md files with progressive-disclosure structure, verifies them against pre-launch, trigger-matching, and behavioral-evaluation gates, and registers plugin-destined skills in plugin.json), and app-store-metadata (draft every text field an App Store submission needs — name, subtitle, promotional text, description, keywords, review notes, the App Privacy label, age-rating answers, and a screenshot shot list — from repository evidence rather than invention, save it as a reviewable Korean draft under docs/release/, and only after approval type the fields into App Store Connect with claude-in-chrome, never touching a submit control), and us-monthly-dividend (design and review US monthly-dividend income portfolios — builds a Jan-Dec dividend calendar that fills every month from a budget, proposes the covered-call cap and ticker count from market conditions via VIX/US-10Y data plus three parallel analyst subagents with user confirmation, rebalances an existing account when new money is added — buy-only allocation of the new cash to underweight tickers with a Swedroe 5/25 band check and sells only on explicit opt-in, analyzes existing holdings for coverage gaps, computes after-tax cash flow for a Korean resident via the 15% US treaty withholding, flags dividend cuts with deterministic OK/WARN/REVIEW verdicts from a bundled yfinance script, and files the Korean report into Obsidian via obs with an optional Google Sheets export — modeled on the user's own portfolio sheet with target weights, 5/25 band bounds, cost basis, FX gain, and rebalance orders — that a later rebalance run can reload as the account state). Agent: korean-reviewer (proofreads generated Korean documents for unnatural phrasing). Hook: auto-suggests korean-reviewer after .md/.html/.pptx docs are written. The obs* skills read the vault path from $OBSIDIAN_VAULT, defaulting to ~/workspace/obsidian/MyObsidian. Also ships an opt-in animated emoji status line (statusline/) that shows working 🤖🧠 vs idle 😴💤 — copy in and configure your own settings.json.
